_note: Per-component versions for independently shipped parts. The product version is the VERSION file (ADR-0011). ICS core always equals the product version.

interfaces.agent_protocol_note: 2 = signed requests carry the controller epoch (warm standby, ADR-0012). An agent below 0.2.0 does not know the field: the ICS falls back to epoch-less requests for that node (agentclient legacy path, rechecked every 300 s) so mixed fleets keep working, but such a node is not fenced against a resurrected old primary. Minimum compatible agent for fencing: 0.2.0.

release_names._note: One name per MINOR release line, alphabetical (ADR-0011 §1). Add the next name when a line opens.
